decision: Determine whether the width-512 J3 model at its method-appropriate 5e-4 learning rate provides a seed-stable capacity gain over the existing matched width-256 1e-3 anchor. Run only seeds 1 and 2 because seed 0 is already valid at 0.685 strict and 0.930 slack-two, while the matched anchor is already available for seeds 0, 1, and 2 at 0.660, 0.670, and 0.685 strict. Promote width 512 only if the paired three-seed mean strict-success gain is at least 0.03, no seed loses slack-two success relative to its matched anchor, all losses are finite, state_std is at least 0.5, and state effective rank is at least 64. Otherwise retain width 256 and move to the supported grounded-objective combination screen. The seed-0 width-512 process failure is classified as post-evaluation infrastructure-only because probes and both primary planning artifacts completed before optional matplotlib import failed; the current snapshot skips that optional plot when matplotlib is unavailable.
